hypotheses.hypothesis: Correctness-sensitive storage can close the WAL-reset blocker only with either an attested fixed SQLite object or a machine-checked product topology that makes WAL plus multiple connections plus concurrent write/checkpoint unreachable.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Topology proof is sufficient and avoids runtime divergence; alternatively, exact fixed lineage alone is sufficient without product binding.
hypotheses.falsifier: Startup must reject vulnerable lineage whenever adversarial second-writer/checkpoint reachability exists; fixed 3.53.4 must allow the same topology. Bind object hash, loader path, source ID and topology in every receipt; inject second writer/checkpoint and crash boundaries.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Every evaluator-executable callable site must be analyzer-visible and effect-classified: ExecutableCallableSites is a subset of AdmittedCallableSites.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Runtime fail-closed _eval_call checks and unsupported-node rejection are sufficient even if static traversal is incomplete.
hypotheses.falsifier: Generate AST-carrier x target-kind x effect-class cases, compare an independent walker with instrumented executed call sites, and require set inclusion. Any parser expansion automatically reopens the gate; cover MethodChain separately.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learning and DONE must wait until a persisted selection-to-delivery-to-reconstruction-to-use-to-verified-effect-to-causal-credit ancestry chain validates.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: In-process references are sufficient; durable IDs are diagnostic only.
hypotheses.falsifier: On the storage-bound successor, independently and jointly splice all three IDs across restart/replay/epoch boundaries; every splice must fail before REENTERED and create no learning row, while truthful controls reach DONE.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Any identity used for authority, deduplication or audit joins must retain at least 128 bits or bind/check the full canonical tuple and digest.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The 64-bit values are low-volume diagnostics; targeted preimage resistance and full tuple checks elsewhere are adequate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Force digest-prefix collisions between different endpoint/cost/body tuples through a test seam. Every consumer must reject tuple mismatch; version authority-relevant schemas with full digests. Do not weaken the full-256-bit payment-latch key.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Protected observer provenance plus preregistered topology-specific leakage/intervention-fidelity tripwires outperforms sample count while meeting <=5% selective error and zero negative-control promotion.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A scalar trusted-quality threshold or trusted origin alone is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: On fresh seeds, longer/asynchronous blocks, semantic source swaps and an independently implemented evaluator, reject if error exceeds 5%, any negative-control promotion occurs, or coverage collapses to universal abstention.

hypotheses.hypothesis: WIT compatibility is necessary but insufficient for least authority; host-owned attenuated/revocable grants, budgets and external receipts are independent invariants.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A precise WIT world itself is the effective capability boundary.
hypotheses.falsifier: For every omitted import and every granted import, attempt filesystem/network/clock/random/provider effects under composition, restart and confused-deputy routing. Omitted effects must be unreachable; grants must attenuate/revoke; receipts must originate outside guest control.

hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Ranking scores inevitably become de facto reward/authority and create novelty chasing or activity bias.
hypotheses.falsifier: Crash between lease release and goal transition, restart with ACTIVE/DORMANT ambiguity, saturate novelty/impossible goals, mutate score inputs, and require no external effect without a new canonical gate receipt.
